name: box-multi-tracker-example-simple-ecommerce
description: A small React + Vite storefront that uses box-multi-tracker with two independent analytics instances. Installs the SDK from a packed tarball, exactly as an external consumer would.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && vite build
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
